# dr_flac provenance

`dr_flac.h` and `LICENSE.txt` are vendored from
[`mackron/dr_libs`](https://github.com/mackron/dr_libs) commit
`b55a0d9a30b91ad8901f89ecf05f76a33186c185`. The tracked files have SHA-256:

```text
D947F54784467160D30DCA540542BF92CED94965703E5DEEB9E82DB2EC5E0C02  dr_flac.h
DD1C647E6F767F8FF4B2DFAE0FED314726600A01E0CF1EF556AFDDD5FA96FF15  LICENSE.txt
```

PSRadio distributes the decoder under the retained MIT No Attribution
(MIT-0) option. Standard file I/O is disabled; streaming uses bounded custom
read, forward-seek, and allocation callbacks.
